requirement.original:
1. 从行程中移除餐厅后（拖到右侧），右侧候选列表中看不到该餐厅了
2. 餐厅类型不能锁定——餐厅就是餐厅，不区分早/午/晚
3. 同一顿晚餐可以有多个备选餐厅（options[]）
4. 移除飞机餐（飞行日）后，右侧候选列表不更新了
5. 从右侧拖到左侧后，右侧的卡片还在——应该是移动，不是复制
6. 右侧面板不支持移动端——移动端应该移到底部
7. 拖放应该影响时间线右侧：时间线右侧应只显示已在面板中选中的项，用户拖到时间线来排定时间
8. 交通卡片不能拖拽
9. 修改计划后预算不更新
requirement.clarified: Fix four confirmed bugs in react_template.tpl: (1+4) items removed from board vanish from sidebar instead of reappearing unselected; (5) sidebar→board drag should remove card from sidebar (move not copy); (9) per-category budget breakdown goes stale after plan changes. Also fix cosmetic label (2): meal cards should show neutral 'Restaurant' label not slot-specific label. Issues 3/6/7/8 are deferred.
requirement.what: Bug fixes in CandidatesSidebar visibility, move semantics, and budget category update logic
requirement.why: Four user-reported functional regressions degrade the core trip editing workflow — users cannot see candidates they removed, cannot tell moved items are gone from sidebar, and see stale budget figures.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Four user-reported bugs: (1+4) removed board items disappear from sidebar; (5) sidebar card stays after board drop; (9) budget categories stale after edits; (2) meal type label implies slot restriction
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Issues 1+4: CandidatesSidebar.mealsGroup is built exclusively from editorDay.slots[slotId].options[] — items present only in publishedDay.meals are never synthesized into options[] and therefore never appear in sidebar, before or after drag. Issue 5: applySelection never removes option from editorTripData.slots[originSlotId].options[] — by M17b design, selection is highlighted not moved. Issue 9: recomputeBudget discards entry.budget from API response; only day_total is persisted; effectiveDay.budget traces to static publishedDay.budget. Issue 2: mealsLabel at line 2497 renders _originSlotId slot name, misleading user into thinking option is slot-restricted.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — not a regression; original design gaps
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: CandidatesSidebar was designed to show only v2-format options from editorTripData; PLAN-format items in publishedDay were not bridged. recomputeBudget was designed to update the total display only. M17b spec specified highlight-not-move for sidebar selections.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Users expect removed items to be recoverable from the sidebar; they expect a drag-to-board to be a move; they expect budget figures to refresh after edits.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Original implementation; no recent regression identified.

development_approach.strategy: Four targeted surgical changes within react_template.tpl: (1) handleSidebarDrop gains a 'preserveMealOption' helper (mirrors preserveCurrentAccommodationOption) that synthesizes the deselected meal back into editorTripData.slots[srcSlotId].options[]; (2) applySelection gains a removal block that removes the option from origin slot options[] when direction is 'candidates'; (3) recomputeBudget extends its .then handler to merge entry.budget into editorTripData.days[n].budget via setEditorTripData, guarded by budgetSeqRef; (4) line 2497 label replaced with fixed 'Restaurant'/'餐厅'.
development_approach.validation_approach: QA verifies via browser: (a) drag a plan-default meal from board to sidebar and confirm it reappears unselected; (b) drag a sidebar candidate to board and confirm it disappears from sidebar; (c) make any selection and confirm budget category rows update; (d) confirm meal card labels in sidebar show 'Restaurant' not slot names.
